note_for_reviewer: What is traced and what is new: the artwork of each emblem is image_trace's vector trace of the reference picture in the state repo's refs/hebrew-emblem-v2/ (hand-made, not by funkbox), with the lettering lifted out (emblem/trace/: preview and found text lines; the trace settings are in each emblem-*.poster.json's art layer file emblem-*.art.svg). The words are funkbox text layers from emblem/emblem.copy.json, positioned with poster_fit; emblem/renders/*.text_audit.json shows them exact. The video does not claim the artwork was drawn by funkbox. The emblem redraws an existing organisation's emblem; the two IDF-insignia mashups (shots mash-b, mash-c) are covered by owner_approval.json, which approves that content only.
